class.name: OpenXRMetaSpatialEntityGroupSharingExtension
class.description: Wraps the [code]XR_META_spatial_entity_group_sharing[/code] extension, which shares spatial anchors with a group UUID and loads anchors previously shared with that group. Enable this extension in Project Settings under [code]xr/openxr/extensions/meta/spatial_entity_group_sharing[/code]. A typical flow is to create a spatial anchor, enable [constant OpenXRFbSpatialEntity.COMPONENT_TYPE_STORABLE], save it to [constant OpenXRFbSpatialEntity.STORAGE_CLOUD], enable [constant OpenXRFbSpatialEntity.COMPONENT_TYPE_SHARABLE], and pass it to [method share_anchors]. On another device, call [method load_group_anchors] with the same group UUID, then call [method OpenXRFbSpatialEntity.track] on each loaded anchor.

method.name: get_last_result_code
method.description: Returns the raw [code]XrResult[/code] value from the most recent [method share_anchors] operation.

method.name: get_last_result_string
method.description: Returns a readable name for the raw [code]XrResult[/code] value from the most recent [method share_anchors] operation.

method.name: is_group_sharing_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if spatial entity group sharing is supported by the current OpenXR runtime.

method.name: load_group_anchors
method.description: Loads up to [param max_results] spatial anchors shared with [param group_uuid] from cloud storage. [param timeout] is the query timeout in seconds; [code]0.0[/code] uses the runtime's immediate query behavior. Returns [code]true[/code] if the asynchronous request was accepted. The loaded [OpenXRFbSpatialEntity] objects are delivered by [signal openxr_meta_group_anchors_loaded].

method.name: share_anchors
method.description: Shares the [OpenXRFbSpatialEntity] objects in [param anchors] with [param group_uuid]. Each anchor must already be saved to [constant OpenXRFbSpatialEntity.STORAGE_CLOUD] and have [constant OpenXRFbSpatialEntity.COMPONENT_TYPE_SHARABLE] enabled. Returns [code]true[/code] if the asynchronous request was accepted. Completion is reported by [signal openxr_meta_group_anchors_shared].

signal.name: openxr_meta_group_anchors_loaded
signal.description: Emitted when [method load_group_anchors] completes. [param anchors] contains the loaded [OpenXRFbSpatialEntity] objects and is empty if no matching anchors were returned.
